title: How UK automotive exports contribute to the EU’s economy
gist: An SMMT-commissioned Oxford Economics report argues that excluding UK automotive from the EU's proposed 'Made in Europe' policy would hurt UK production and also the EU economy given €5.6bn of related EU spending.

insights.claim: If the EU's proposed 'Made in Europe' policy excludes UK automotive, UK sector competitiveness and production volumes could weaken, with wider consequences across the EU.
insights.speaker: Sanele Mjikane
insights.so_what: Trade-policy risk to UK auto producers and EU suppliers.

insights.claim: UK auto production exported to the EU is associated with €5.6bn of spending on EU goods and services, about 58,000 EU jobs and €1.6bn in EU tax revenues, reaching transport, professional services, real estate and utilities.
insights.speaker: Sanele Mjikane
insights.so_what: Quantifies the EU's stake, a lobbying argument for UK inclusion.
